page.overview:
What is Horn of Gondor?

Horn of Gondor is an unofficial, non-profit short film by a group of enthusiast filmmakers. As a Middle-earth fan-film, it is not affiliated with the Tolkien Estate or New Line Cinema and was produced as an entirely non-commercial film. The film is based on the chapter "Cirion and Eorl and the Friendship of Gondor and Rohan" in . On September 18 of 2020, it was [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wVFtSUQm-jQ released on YouTube].

After the invasion of the fierce hordes of Balchoth, Gondor is on the brink of destruction. The Ruling Steward Cirion places his hope on the half-forgotten nation of the Horselords in the north. Will the knight Borondir succeed and convey Cirion's message?

Music by [http://www.imdb.com/name/nm7739226/ Petr Kubelik]. See: [http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFB7xQHB6Y9Cdk-6CNxSRgX2NT8f1Ti6M Horn of Gondor Original Motion Picture Soundtrack].
